metadata.description: The loopkeeper core and its add-on plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: loopkeeper
plugins.description: A stage machine with approval gates, change-control gates with a plan-scoped file budget, model routing, bounded review loops and a decision log in one plugin.

plugins.name: lk-pr-watch
plugins.description: PR and CI state for the current branch above the prompt, a /pr pane, toasts on transitions, and a note to Claude when a check fails.

plugins.name: lk-token-budget
plugins.description: A token budget for the session and each subagent, and a prompt-cache timer: a band with the cache countdown and cold-resend cost, pings before it goes cold, a manual Keep warm and an opt-in capped auto keep-warm, and a /budget pane.

plugins.name: lk-agent-map
plugins.description: An agent deck for the session's subagents: cards with cost, tokens, context, model, effort and progress, spawn caps, tree and team views, permission waits, idle alerts and a per-agent Stop button, in an /agent-map pane and a band.

plugins.name: lk-attention
plugins.description: Tells you when Claude needs you or finished something long: a native GNOME notification, a sound, a toast, a band above the prompt and an /attention inbox.

plugins.name: lk-handoff-guard
plugins.description: Never lose a session to the context limit: watches context fill, writes a session handoff into the project's .claude/brain/ folder before it is too late, then clears and resumes from it.

plugins.name: lk-secret-guard
plugins.description: A seatbelt that stops credential-shaped strings and a private deny-list of words from being written into files or shell commands, with a band and a /secret-guard pane.

plugins.name: lk-where-am-i
plugins.description: One line above the prompt with the repo, branch and worktree, how dirty it is, and the account's usage windows and prompt cache, with a /where pane.
